title: Light and Crunchy Filipino Cornmeal Biko
description: A traditional Filipino dessert featuring a delicate agave-leaf-wrapped cornmeal cake with a sweet and tangy jam filling.
instructions: Prepare the agave leaves by rinsing them with water and patting them dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, whisk together the cornmeal, grated coconut, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the coconut milk, eggs, melted coconut oil, vanilla extract, and pandan extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until well combined.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat and cook the cornmeal mixture until it forms a thick batter.
Wrap the agave leaves in a small bundle and place them in the skillet or griddle.
Spoon the cornmeal batter into the agave leaves, molding it into a small cake shape.
Cook the cake for 2-3 minutes on each side, until it is lightly browned and crispy.
While the cake is cooking, prepare the caramelized sugar by heating a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sugar to the saucepan and cook, stirring constantly, until it is caramelized and golden brown.
Once the cake is cooked, remove it from the skillet or griddle and let it cool for a few minutes.
Drizzle the caramelized sugar over the top of the cake and serve immediately.
